en: I'm sorry, I'm quite tired. Don't mind me though, use the bed if you need it.
Maybe we can cut a deal, yeah? You let me go and I'll give you some keys! You can loot the place, and I'll quietly fuck off! Come on, that's a good deal, right?
No, you aren't here to join us, are you? Travelers looking to pass east, I'd wager. Excellent. It seems I'd worried for nothing.
Of course. Go on through.
Stop right there!
Thanks! I'm sure they have something good stashed somewhere around here. Maybe. Oh, and there's a key for moving into the pass, too, you'll want that one.

That little wretch, Grae, came to the commune a few weeks ago, and he's already attracted more attention than any of the others. He could never outshine me, of course, but I worry he might start thinking that he actually has some influence.
Ugh, more? Listen you little worm, I am the one destined to be Frico's queen, so you can just turn around and...
Well? Go and do it. I'm not giving you the key until Grae is dead.
What's your business taking this route?
What? How dare you!
Whoah! Easy, easy! You're here to like... purge the place of vampire-worshippers, right?
Claire Sand, Lady of the Guilds
First Lady of Whetners, Lina Maize
Gerald
Here lies his honour Prime Minister Elgar

King Spar, 
who wished to be buried neath the blue sky
Lord Wyatt, whose magicks saved many lives
Mother Veda, who suffered so others need not
Olivia Wise, who fought for common folk
Prince Kalf, who never saw the sun
Samuel Bright, beloved poet
Tam Brennan, Queen's Maid

This man died to protect Princess Chelsea. 
We know not his name.
Windyssa, mother to the motherless
only worms remember me
Anyway, I think I'll help these guys clean up a bit before moving on. There are a few monsters around that I dodged earlier, so watch yourself.
I don't know what we would have done if you hadn't showed up. Thank you.
I knew this detour was a trap, I just knew it.
I thought that I could get them to fight back by setting an example, but there were too many. It would've been a slaughter.
I'm not even with these guys actually, I was just walking them through the pass. They seemed like they could use the help. Ugh, I'm going to get myself killed at this rate.
Out of the way, folks! Heads down and you'll be okay!
We got them! That was amazing!
We wouldn't have come out of that alive if you hadn't come along.
Well, that was more exciting than I was hoping this trip was going to be.
What the... we got some idiots playing hero over here. Take 'em out!
Whew, good job there. Sorry I didn't jump in, I was trying to make sure none of those bastards broke off to take a hostage.
Wow, that was some fight! I don't know what we'd have done if you hadn't come along!
The darkness keeps her hidden, the darkness keeps her safe.
Bastards, all of them! I've hardly got enough room in here to think, let alone move, but I need to come up with a plan to get away from these insane cultists. Who knows what they plan to do to me?
Test subjects one and three were given the blue formula. Zombification occurred within 5 hours. Two and four were given the red formula, and are ready for mana immersion.
As my host led me upstairs, another striking set of nearly identical pieces only further punctuated the squalid state of this forsaken island.
I was prepared for something a good deal more macabre when I first entered the estate, so imagine my surprise to find myself greeted by such civilized statuary.

My host must have caught me staring, for he launched into a most thorough account of the history of the pieces. Had I been less tired, I'd have listened more earnestly, but I excused myself early. The agreed-upon price for these accomodations will require all my strength.
I'm just putting a fresh log on the fire. Come on in and make yourself at home.
Why hello, deary,
Even if you managed to talk me into it, I have a lot of trees to fell. I've already been paid for it and I can't leave until the job is done. You understand.
I see. Well, if you don't mind, I've got a lot of work to do. If there's nothing else, I should get to it.
Oh ho, is that so? That's quite a thing to ask for, you know.
Oh, I almost forgot. Can't leave my favorite axe behind.
Oh, hello. Not a lot of visitors way out here. Did you need something?
Sorry, what was it you wanted again?
Was that you making all that noise out back? You cut down all those trees?
Well, I ain't got shit to do now. Guess I'll just relax for now. Thanks!
Well, fuck.
Well, you scratched my back, so it's only fair I scratch yours, right? Just give me a minute to gather up some things.

Lucky I, to find such loot
ungrabbed by giants' greedy hands,
but now I think it's time to boot
in search of other wealthy lands.
Bring me one of them gold potions, alright? That should get me on my feet and in fighting shape again.
Damn, that's the good stuff, isn't it?
I figured I was dead, but I found dry land again and made my way up here to this lighthouse. Whoever lit this thing saved me life, or what's left of it anyway.
I was thrown clear of the ship, and I saw him. The thing what sunk us. It was all darkness and churning, but I saw him. Then I spied this light, so I swim toward it for all I'm worth.
I'd like to come with you. You're my crew, after all, but me belly was torn open on the rocks. It ain't bleeding too bad right now, but every time I stand up and move around it gets worse.
I'm a man of my word, as you know. You just say the word, and I'm with you.
You got the potion? I know those ones are rare, but I don't think anything less is going to do the trick.
You! I thought for certain you'd all drowned out there!
... it is a profound shame to have such a gift refused.
A Bogani stone is really just a bezoar. The hopeful orc imbibes a seed concoction to begin the process, and then the stone grows in his gut.
A Bogani stone?
A short length of your gut was utterly destroyed, but I removed it and reconnected what was left. You probably won't even notice.
Ah, finally awake! You've nothing to worry about, everything went well.
Ah, then I will not insist, but it is your loss, I assure you!
All finished. I trust you feel well?
Alright. See you soon, then.
An orc man! Most orc men would kneel at a simple asking. He must be magnificent indeed for you to want to court him so.
An orc man, actually.
And here you go, one cold tea coming right up! Enjoy!
And the stone? How did it turn out?
Any other healer might destroy the stone in the process, and after all your suffering, you'll be wanting to keep it.
Applesauce.
Are you hungry then? Well, that's what it's there for! It's all-you-can eat for one price. 400$ and you can help yourselves.
As it happens, I have a great deal of personal interest in orcish courtship right now.
Best stay out of the church. We don't use it, and if it collapses, I'm not sending someone in to pull you out.
But... I don't really think you can afford this right now. Come back when you've got more money!
Come again when you feel weary!
Come back when you are ready, and I will remove it for you.
Come on now, don't be shy! I just put out a fresh spread!
Curse away. I'll be waiting, and I'll keep my scalpel sharp and oiled.
Did you need something, dear? The community house should have everything you need. Best stock up before you head out again.
Disrobe while I prepare my things.
Draped in gold? I think you must have me confused for someone else.
Eventually, however, one of his rivals brought an assassin of his own down upon him, and I was captured. They sent me here, as much to cover up the fact that my order existed as to silence me.
Everyone here has a story, and now you know mine. My days of killing are long behind me, but I am pleased to have been of some service to you.
Go to the healer, and ask him of the Bogani stone. This sets the flood into motion.
Good day, traveler! Come and let me show you the art of somatic healing. I guarantee you will not be disappointed.
Halt, stranger. You approach the town of Marsaven. You are welcome to enter, but you'll be expected to behave yourselves. Enter the building straight ahead if you're looking to spend some money.
Have you been on the island long? Feels like I've already been here a lifetime.
Have you had enough? Is it time to cut the stone free?
He is magnificent. Please, tell me about the ritual.
He probably doesn't even know what they are, and I can't afford to be debilitated for who knows how long. I'm really sorry for bothering you.
Hey you. Wanna buy something rare and wonderful?
Hey, you stay away from that! It's not even ready, besides. You want something to eat, you come see me.
Hmm? I'm sorry, I don't have any potions for sale. I think there's a baba in the marketplace if you need some.
How do you feel?
I Do
I Want One
I admit I did not have high expectations of you, but I am impressed. This stone is fine indeed. Larger and smoother than mine, to be sure.
I am flexible with your contribution, but I must insist on 50$ at minimum. It may be simple, but it still requires effort from me. You understand.
I assume you're ready to see your prize! It's hardened up nicely overnight.
I can count, you know. Come back when you've got enough coin to afford it!
I cannot tell for certain how firm or large it is however, and only you can decide on the limits of your body.
I do lots of things that are usually the province of men. I can handle it. Please tell me about the stones.
I don't much care for this place, to be truthful, but I care even less for raw wilderness survival. What a place we've ended up in.
I don't normally talk about that, but you've been most generous, so I suppose you deserve to know.
I don't think you-

I escaped from the prison with relative ease, and thought to make a living here for myself once again as an assassin, but as it turns out, death and pain are in abundant supply here, and there is little demand for more of it.
I hope so. Thank you for everything.
I see a choice that welds a golden chain around you forever. The first link of that chain is forged here.
I see a sword that cuts down your foes, and I see red eyes in the dark that cut through your flesh with greater ease still.
I sense that you work well with others, and you should avoid going out-of-doors tomorrow.

I trained in a monastic order, where I learned the limits of the body, and how to manipulate it. They trained me to be an assassin. I was meant to use these techniques to paralyze and subdue, so that the victim would not struggle. For a time, I worked in the employ of a noble lord doing exactly that.
I understand. It is not something to be undertaken lightly.
I was glad to do it. It does my heart good to see such a dedicated love alive and well in a place like this.
I will still be here when you change your mind!

I would be happy to do this for you, or for any of your companions, for only 50$, though I am quite sure you will find that to be a bargain. If you feel that it is worth more, you can decide the amount for yourself. What say you?
I'd put my life on the line for his. I can tolerate it.
I'll just go on takin' care of the little things, so folk like you are free to take care of the big things.
I'm going into surgery. Please see that I am not interrupted.
I'm not here for that. I wanted to know about the Bogani stone.
I'm sorry, I don't have any potions for sale right now. You should go to the market if you need something. There's a lovely woman who-
I'm sorry, but even at 40$, that's me doin' you a favor. I can't let it go for less.
I'm sorry, but you can't afford that. Look, I ain't heartless, I won't let you starve. It isn't the good stuff, but maybe this will take the edge off.
I've got the blood of the underground beast, bottled and preserved. An alchemist can use it to make a youth potion, or you could brew it into a beer that will let you screw for days without stopping!
If there's nothing else, I have a lot of work yet to do today.
If you just can't get enough, come back anytime. I've got all you could ever want!
In the dark, perfection waxes, waiting to be never seen, leash in hand of demon blackest, rapt 'round throat of sunken king. That is what the wind whispers of you.
It feels like I'm giving birth to a gnashing demon!

It is a long, agonizing process, but it is meant to be. He holds the stone within his gut for as long as he can possibly tolerate it, and then, it is cut out of his body and polished as a gem. He presents this product of his own flesh and his own suffering to his beloved, usually in a bid for marriage.
It is considered a profound honour to receive such a gift, and...

It is quite simple for one who knows how. I search your flesh and bones for your aches, your tension, and your weariness, and I pluck them out and discard them. I will leave you lighter, stronger, and sounder of mind, and I would ask only a pittance of coin for my time.
It's a fairly impressive stone, all told.
It's fine. Not so much as scratched. I have it in the kiln now to dry out.
It's important.
Just 15000$, and it's all yours!
Just leave your clothes and equipment on the floor.
Keep your nose clean while you're here. I know we all come from questionable backgrounds, but we work hard to keep this place safe. Please respect it.
Looks good, dunnit? Raspberry cold tea, that is, made right here. You've never tasted sweeter, I can promise. Just 50$ if you'd like one.
Me?
Nevermind
No! I will see this through! I just... wanted to be certain that nothing was abnormal.
No. I see the firelight, the furs, and golden skin glistening with sweat from your body.
Not Yet
Of course. Goodbye.
Of course. Lay down over here and I'll examine you.
Oh, hello again. I trust you are feeling well.
One day, this whole island may swing from that golden chain. Best weld the seams tightly.
Please, I can't stand it any longer! Get this thing out of my body!
Right. I will.
Sit there on the bed. This won't take long.
So that is what she meant.
So? Still interested in getting one of these stones?
Some of your companions came looking for you, but I told them to come back in the morning. Lay back down, give my salves a chance to heal your wounds, and get some sleep.
Sorry to bother you.
Sorry to bother you. I don't need your stone.
Take It Out!
Take it to a competent jeweler, and forge it into something fitting for your lover. I'm sure he will be moved by the gesture.
The Bogani were an ancient orc people, and their stones were part of a brutal courtship ritual. You've no interest in that, surely.
The healer is in the house near the west exit. Go to him.
The stone is forming up nicely.
The stones are usually the province of men, though I suppose there's no reason a woman couldn't obtain one.
Then you'll have to excuse me. I have a lot of herbs to process.
Then you've just made my day a lot more interesting.
There used to be a grand field here long ago. Oat, I think. I can't remember the last time I had oat. It doesn't matter anyway, the forest swallowed it up long before we arrived.
They are rare and precious, and at once everywhere and worthless. I doubt you have use for such a thing.
This place is decent enough. Repairing a ruined town is a lot easier than building a new one. I mean, it has to be, right?
This will knock you out. Drink it and lie down.
Very well. I already have my tools set aside. Come this way.
We get more visitors than I ever expected we would. There are a few small communities, and I think everybody knows that we need each other to survive. Trade is... surprisingly brisk.
We'll just close the screen then. You won't be needing any clothes, either.
Well don't wait too long, you hear? It won't stay cold forever, and I'll sell out before long, just you wait and see!
Well then you got a deal. I hope it serves you well in all your... erm... logging.
Well then, you are now officially my guests. You just go on and help yourselves to as much as you like!
Well, before the misery sets in, let me say thanks. I might be cursing your name later.
Well, it sounds like everything is progressing properly, then.
Well, let's get you alone then!
Well, that's fine. You probably want somethin' fancier anyway.
Well. Bottoms up.

What is in short supply, however, is comfort, and my techniques are versatile, as you can no doubt attest to. Ever since I began using my talents to remove pain instead of causing it, I have been very busy indeed, and there is something redeeming in that.
Why are you telling me all of this?
Yes, of course, Orum.
Yes, you. The one draped in gold. Come here.
You definitely won't regret it!

You don't look like the sort who deals in lumber and grain, am I right? I ain't got much in the way of steel, but I can sell you an axe if you want. It's more for fellin' than killin', but it'll do the job sure enough. How's 40$?
You just have a look at what we've got, and give a holler if you want to buy something.
You must be impressed with me indeed. For that, I'll use every technique I know. Perhaps you should tell your friends to browse. We may be a while.
You should go. Enjoy walking around while you can still do it without pain.
You should go. Your companions will come looking for you soon.
You there!
You will make a grave mistake, but make it you must, for all our sakes. The one to pay the price for that mistake is yet to come. It will not be your burden, nor mine, nor anyone you yet could find.
You will not be disappointed. Now, let's have a little privacy.

You'll be feeling very bad very soon. Tolerate it as long as you possibly can, and then return to me. I know just the place in the gut where the stone will grow, and I'll be able to get it out with minimal damage to you and to the stone.
You'll change your mind sooner or later. Your curiosity will get the better of you! I'll be waiting.
You'll come back! The smell will haunt you till you do!
You're back, and you are not looking well.
You've an orc woman you love dearly, then?
You've returned! I am not surprised. If you would like another session, my fee is the same, 50$.
Also, I've never had to give a goblin a pep-talk before so I think you must be something different.
